findings.issue: A failed repackage can leave the previous complete manifest beside changed build inputs.
findings.disposition: Confirmed local build-directory limitation. Packaging fails and independent verification rejects the mismatch. Retry packaging from the intended inputs before upload. Whole-build rollback is outside the approved manifest transaction.

findings.issue: The portable regression suite covers missing files and directories but omits direct evidence for an unreadable regular file.
findings.disposition: Parent verified the production gate using an isolated regular binary with mode 000 under uid 1000. Verification failed before host execution.
